ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, $\angle AOB$ is a straight angle, $\angle AOC=80^\circ$, $\angle BOD=30^\circ$, $OM$ and $ON$ are the angle bisectors of $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$ respectively. What is the degree measure of $\angle MON$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOB$ is a straight angle,\\
$\therefore \angle AOB=180^\circ$,\\
since OM and ON are the bisectors of $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOD$, respectively, and $\angle AOC=80^\circ$, $\angle BOD=30^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle AOM=\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC=40^\circ$, $\angle BON=\frac{1}{2}\angle BOD=15^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle MON=\angle AOB-\angle AOM-\angle BON=180^\circ-40^\circ-15^\circ=\boxed{125^\circ}$.
